name: remoteedit
description: Browse, edit, and save remote files over SSH/SFTP, FTP, and FTPS directly from VS Code.

enumDescriptions: Show the Remote Edit button in the Editor Title area.
Hide the Remote Edit Editor Title button.
remoteedit.editorTitleButtonPosition.description: Controls whether the Remote Edit button appears in the editor title area.

enumDescriptions: Show the Remote Edit button on the left side of the Status Bar.
Show the Remote Edit button on the right side of the Status Bar.
Hide the Remote Edit Status Bar button.
remoteedit.statusBarButtonPosition.description: Controls where the Remote Edit status bar button appears.

enumDescriptions: Show both the icon and the Remote Edit text.
Show only the Remote Edit icon.
Show only the Remote Edit text.
remoteedit.statusBarButtonStyle.description: Controls how the Remote Edit status bar button is displayed.

remoteedit.statusBarButtonPriority.description: Controls the Remote Edit status bar button priority. Higher values appear closer to the left within the selected alignment group.

remoteedit.sshReadyTimeout.description: Controls how long Remote Edit waits, in milliseconds, for an SSH connection to become ready.

remoteedit.sshKeepAliveInterval.description: Controls the SSH keep-alive interval, in milliseconds, when Keep Connection Alive is enabled.

remoteedit.sshKeepAliveCountMax.description: Controls how many unanswered SSH keep-alive messages are allowed before the connection is considered lost.

remoteedit.sftpResolveOwnerGroupNames.description: Resolve numeric SFTP owner/group IDs to readable names during file listing. Enable this if owner/group appears as numbers. May slow down directory browsing on some servers.

remoteedit.ftpKeepAliveInterval.description: Controls the FTP/FTPS keep-alive interval, in milliseconds, when Keep Connection Alive is enabled.

remoteedit.maxConcurrentTransfers.description: Controls how many file transfers Remote Edit can run at the same time. Set to 1 to process transfers sequentially.

remoteedit.sudoTempDirectory.description: Remote directory used for temporary files when SFTP sudo mode saves privileged files. The connected SFTP user must be able to write to this directory.

remoteedit.restoreSpecialPermissionBits.description: Restore original setuid, setgid, and sticky permission bits after saving existing remote files, when the remote system allows it.

remoteedit.directoryListingCacheTtl.description: Time in seconds to reuse recently loaded remote directory listings. Set to 0 to disable cache. Manual refresh always reloads from the server.

remoteedit.diagnostics.debugLogs.description: Enable detailed debug logs for Remote Edit diagnostics.

remoteedit.diagnostics.performanceLogs.description: Enable performance logs for directory listing, rendering, cache, and transfer diagnostics.

colors.description: Foreground color used to highlight Remote Edit connections while Sudo Mode is enabled.
